stable.finish-args-home-filesystem-access: MultiAGENT is a local coding workspace and needs read/write access to user-selected project checkouts, worktrees, and generated diffs without copying source trees into private app storage.
stable.finish-args-flatpak-spawn-access: MultiAGENT bridges to user-installed host coding-agent CLIs such as Codex, OpenCode, Git, and shell commands so credentials and toolchains remain in the user's normal Linux environment instead of being bundled into the Flatpak.
